        "The backout message explicitly attributes Mac test failure, without giving a mechanism. Do not infer that an XML namespace, credentials, callback timing or fake payload caused that failure from the inverted source alone. The original focused EWS completion lesson already separates these phases and is linked rather than duplicated.",
        "Read the necessary accepted current shared inbox test, sync-loop end, actual common operation result handler, safe listener and native success consumer. Current success updates counts and runs mOnStop; it is not the removed direct FolderLoaded callback body. Current fake MIME/header support is present again with later changes. No current equivalence to the backed-out exact code, all server properties or protocol success is inferred.",
        "Manual style/naming check preserves original versus current callback/interface names, plain fake-endpoint lint exception scope and account/helper cleanup roles. The patch removes test scenarios and adds no direct regression assertion. Current shared tests have unread-count and server-idle oracles; current unrelated assertion/comment issues are not attributed to this backout. No Mac, browser, Rust/native build, EWS fetch or accessibility test was run.",
        "Read full retained Bug 1975706 description/comments 0–11, updates/footer. The umbrella asks for EWS message download testing. The first browser-test expansion explicitly does not add unit tests; later OAuth, bad-password, certificate/connection-error and pagination stages are distinct. Reported first landing ee18f3d4f5dc and later landing e892a607eeea are not silently treated as the same source tree.",

        "Independently verified all six restored blobs equal the original landing parent and retained the exact first/backout/later-reland relationship receipt.
